name: codex-long-term-memory
description: Cross-thread conversation memory for Codex using SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, and Stop hooks with model-backed summaries and captions.

interface.shortDescription: Install and manage Codex hook-based conversation memory.
interface.longDescription: Adds Codex hooks that log prompts, replies, and file context into local history, compacts history hierarchically, refreshes summaries in the background when model calls fail, and injects cross-thread context at session start.
